otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.0: Almost every US team that buys an AI note taker runs into the Otter AI vs Fireflies AI question, and Fathom usually joins the shortlist too. Each sends a bot into Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Summaries and action items? All three write them.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.1: So the choice comes down to details: how much the free plan really gives you, how each one prices seats, where the notes go after the call, and how much data each tool keeps. We compare them on exactly those points.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.2: In Otter AI vs Fireflies AI, Otter is transcription-first and Fireflies is integration-first, while Fathom is free-recording-first. Simple, but useful. Most of the differences below follow from it.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.3: On annual billing, Otter Pro is the cheapest at $8.33 a month, then Fireflies Pro at $10 per seat and Fathom Premium at $16. Switch to monthly billing and the numbers move: Otter Pro is $16.99, Fireflies Pro is $18 and Fathom Premium is $20.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.4: There is also a Fathom Team plan at $19 a month or $15 per user billed yearly. Minimum 2 users. Scale to a 10-person team on annual billing and the bill reaches $1,800 a year on Fathom Team, $1,200 on Fireflies Pro and $1,000 on Otter Pro.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.5: Fathom has the best free plan: unlimited recordings and transcriptions, instant AI summaries, and clips. Otter Basic? 300 minutes a month, but each conversation stops at 30 minutes and only the 25 most recent are kept. Fireflies Free comes with limited storage and a small pool of AI credits.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.7: In Otter AI vs Fireflies AI for sales, Fireflies usually wins. Why? Call notes sync into CRMs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, topics get tracked across calls, and every conversation is searchable. Fireflies Business runs $19 per seat billed yearly.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.8: Otter has improved for sales. Its Pro plan adds Salesforce, HubSpot and Zapier integrations, and Enterprise includes an Otter Sales Notetaker. Then there is Fathom's Business plan ($25 billed yearly), with CRM field sync, deal views, coaching metrics and AI scorecards, a strong third option for sales managers who coach from video.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.9: Deeper dive: our guide to [sales conversation intelligence](https://lynkk.ai/blog/sales-conversation-intelligence).
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.10: Otter caps each conversation at 30 minutes on Basic, 90 minutes on Pro and 4 hours on Business. Fireflies lists 2 hours per meeting on Free and Pro, 3 hours on Business and 4 hours on Enterprise, while Fathom puts no cap on recordings at all on its free plan.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.11: Running long workshops, board meetings or training sessions? Check these limits first. A cut-off at minute 90 loses whatever got decided at minute 95.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.12: Both are established vendors with enterprise plans. Fireflies keeps HIPAA compliance and SSO for Enterprise at $39 per seat billed yearly, whereas Otter's Enterprise plan brings SSO, SCIM, domain capture and a HIPAA compliance add-on.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.13: Day to day, though, the bigger risk is control, not breaches:
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.14: Fireflies works by sending a participant called Fred into calls on your calendar, recording audio, then producing a transcript, summary and action items you can search with AskFred. Otter does the same. It also streams a live transcript you can read while the meeting runs.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.15: Prefer no bot? A Fireflies desktop app records through system audio instead. To remove Fred from a live call, type the chat command `/ff leave`; Otter's agent comes off the participant list like any attendee.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.18: Lynkk's bot joins Zoom, Google Meet and Teams, and its Mac app and Chrome extension record without one, including in-person conversations. Languages: 17, including Hindi and Hinglish. Free covers 5 notes a month at up to 2 hours each; Pro is $15 a month. One caveat. CRM sync is not live yet (HubSpot is listed as coming soon), so sales teams that need CRM fields today should look at Fireflies or Fathom Business.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.20: Pick **Otter** if you want live transcripts and the lowest annual price. Teams that run on a CRM and need search across many calls should choose **Fireflies**. Want free unlimited recording with video clips? Go with **Fathom**. And if prep, live answers and Jira-ready follow-up from the same tool matter most, choose **Lynkk**.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.21: Still undecided? Our [Otter.ai alternatives](https://lynkk.ai/blog/otter-ai-alternatives) roundup covers 8 options.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.22: Otter is better for live transcripts and individual use, while Fireflies is better for teams that want CRM sync, topic tracking and search across calls. Price is close. On annual billing it is $8.33 versus $10 a month, so run both on the same 3 meetings before deciding.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.23: Otter is cheaper on annual billing ($8.33 versus $10 for the entry plan). Monthly, Otter Pro costs $16.99 against $18 for Fireflies Pro. Only need recording? Then Fathom's free plan beats both on price, and for paid seats, annual billing saves the most.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.24: Fathom has the best free plan of the three, with unlimited recordings and transcripts. Fireflies goes deeper on integrations; Otter has live transcripts. For anyone who does not want to pay, Fathom is the best starting point. Need CRM sync later? Upgrade then.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.25: Yes, Fireflies records video on its Business plan and above. Fathom records video even on its free plan, while Otter focuses on audio and transcripts. Sharing short clips with colleagues who missed a call is easy with Fathom's free video, something neither Otter nor Fireflies offers for free.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.26: Partly. Fireflies has a desktop app that records system audio without a bot, and Fathom offers bot-free capture in beta, but Otter relies on its meeting agent. Lynkk records bot-free through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Either way, tell attendees.
otter-ai-vs-fireflies-ai.27: All three join Microsoft Teams meetings, each one as a participant in the call. Companies that prefer built-in tools should know Teams' own AI recap requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Check your IT policy first. Some companies block third-party meeting bots in Teams.
